# FocusIDE

> FocusIDE is a free, open source (Apache 2.0) desktop app for working with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI. It shows a plan before any file changes, marks files the agent changes outside the plan while it works, and undoes a whole turn with one key. It runs on your machine with no server, no account and no telemetry. Windows installer today; macOS and Linux build from source.

FocusIDE connects to agents over the Agent Client Protocol (ACP). The user installs and signs in to the agent themselves. FocusIDE never reads, stores or proxies agent credentials. It is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
